nodes.text_en: Which physical part of the AC is cracked, broken, or damaged?
nodes.text_hi: AC ka kaunsa hissa toota ya damage hua hai?

options.label: Outdoor unit casing / Condenser fin bent

nodes.text_en: Is there any exposed high-voltage wiring, internal PCB, or live parts visible through the damage?
nodes.text_hi: Kya toote hisse se koi nanga bijli ka taar ya internal PCB bahar dikh raha hai?

options.label: Yes, exposed wiring or live metal

nodes.text_en: Are the outdoor condenser blue fins bent over a large area, blocking air flow?
nodes.text_hi: Kya outdoor unit ke blue fins mude hue hain jisse hawa ruk rahi hai?

diag_exposed_live_wiring_hazard.probable_cause: Broken Plastic Housing Exposing 230V Mains Terminals
diag_exposed_live_wiring_hazard.rag_query: LG AC broken casing exposed wire safety hazard
diag_exposed_live_wiring_hazard.technician_note: SHUT OFF MCB. Replace damaged front fascia and electrical enclosure cover.

diag_broken_louver_blade.probable_cause: Physical Impact Snapped Horizontal Louver Hinge Pin
diag_broken_louver_blade.rag_query: LG AC horizontal louver vane replacement
diag_broken_louver_blade.technician_note: Snap in replacement genuine louver blade into motor hinge.

diag_cosmetic_front_panel_replace.rag_query: LG AC front panel replacement UW-Q18WUZA

diag_rodent_damaged_power_cord.probable_cause: Rodent / Rat Chewed Power Cord or Interconnecting Cable
diag_rodent_damaged_power_cord.rag_query: LG AC rat bite cable replacement safety
diag_rodent_damaged_power_cord.technician_note: Do not join with tape. Replace full interconnecting cable harness with rodent-proof braided sleeve.

diag_fin_comb_straightening.probable_cause: Bent Aluminum Condenser Fins Restricting Heat Transfer
diag_fin_comb_straightening.rag_query: LG AC condenser fin comb repair
diag_fin_comb_straightening.technician_note: Use fin comb to gently align bent condenser fins.
